title: Consent, privacy notices and legal processing basis
workflow: Select customer-processing purpose and applicable institution privacy policy
Determine qualified legal basis, and whether consent is actually necessary
Show a language-accessible versioned notice to the customer where required
Record signed or authenticated opt-in only for consent-based purposes
Enforce channel/marketing preferences separately from mandatory compliance processing
Handle withdrawal, correction and access requests with lawful retention exceptions
controls: Consent withdrawal cannot automatically delete mandatory AML and financial records
Marketing consent must not be bundled with required identity verification as one forced switch
Do not silently repurpose biometric or ID evidence for unrelated analytics
Track notices, languages, versions and accessible delivery channels
Keep purpose scope and downstream recipients bounded and auditable
Regulatory retention overrides must be source-backed, not guessed or globally hardcoded
planned_test_cases: Withdraw marketing permission while preserving mandatory retention
Wrong notice version cannot be counted as accepted
Unauthorized bulk-export of customer personal data blocked
Right-to-access response applies institution and privacy permissions
review_gate: Qualified local data-protection review, current effective privacy rules, institution retention schedule and accessible notices.
